review.notes: AliStore Courier is a delivery app for electronics retail stores. A store courier sees assigned deliveries and route, records delivery evidence, handles cash-on-delivery and reconciles the completed run. Access is role-based; a store provisions accounts for its own couriers. App Review must receive an active demo courier account with representative non-production review data.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore Courier is the delivery app of a single electronics retail company in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. A courier employed by the company sees the deliveries assigned to them and their route for the day, records the outcome of each handover, handles cash-on-delivery amounts and reconciles the finished run with the store. It is not a consumer app and is not usable without a courier account issued by the company.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Access is role-based and accounts are provisioned from the company ERP back office — there is no self-service registration inside the app, by design. We have created a dedicated review courier account and filled it in the Demo Account fields of this submission, pre-loaded with a representative non-production route (sample deliveries and cash-on-delivery amounts), so review actions never touch live deliveries. Sign in by entering the demo phone number, tapping Continue, and using the one-time code we supply — if it is not visible to you, request it through App Review Notes / Contact and we will relay the current one within minutes. If the demo account stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it from the ERP immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Location is used only to show the assigned route while the app is in use; the app does not track users across apps or websites and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false. Delivery evidence photos stay in the company system and are attached to the order. Cash-on-delivery reconciliation is recorded in an append-only audit ledger scoped to the review store. Push notifications carry delivery assignments only.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.

ru-KG.description: AliStore Courier — приложение доставки для розничных магазинов электроники. Курьер магазина видит назначенные доставки и маршрут, фиксирует результат вручения заказа, ведёт операции с наложенными платежами и сверяет завершённый рейс. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим курьерам.
